Name: Remote Access Storage for Android
Author: Taktl
Description:
Remote Storage Access (Android)

Link your chests into one searchable network and open it with a single key. A touch-friendly Remote Storage Access for Android.

How it works

Open any placed chest and tap Link. Every linked chest in the world then appears together as one grid. Items stay in their real chests, so nothing is stored anywhere hidden. Unlinking a chest never touches what's inside it.

Features

- Link any placed chest from its own menu; tap again to unlink

- Open the network with K (changeable in `config.json`)

- Live search with the Android keyboard, plus filters for category (`#fish`, `#tool`), quality (`*gold`) and tags

- Gift search: type a villager's name with `#` to see which of your stored items they would like as gifts. Works with any giftable villager, including custom ones such as those added by Stardew Valley Expanded. Only items that can be given as gifts are shown

  - `#Abigail` lists every gift for her, grouped by how she feels about it: loves, likes, neutral, dislikes, hates. Each group starts on a new row with an empty row between groups, so the best gifts are at the top

  - `#Abigail-loves`, `#Abigail-likes`, `#Abigail-neutral`, `#Abigail-dislikes` and `#Abigail-hates` show only that group. Base friendship per gift: love +80, like +45, neutral +20, dislike -20, hate -40

  - Combine it with other terms, for example `#Abigail-loves gem`

- Sort by name, count, category or recent, with a button to reverse the order

- Tap an item to withdraw 1; press and hold to withdraw the full stack

- Tap a bag slot to deposit 1, or hold to deposit the whole stack

- Deposit All for one-tap bulk transfers

- Auto-Deposit: items you pick up from drops are sent to your linked chests automatically. Purchases, received items, crafted items and chest withdrawals are never deposited. Tools and toolbar items are skipped. Press B to toggle it (off by default; key changeable with `AutoDepositKey` in `config.json`)

- Remote Crafting: the crafting menu counts items in your linked chests as if they were in your bag, so you can craft without carrying the ingredients. Also works in Robin's carpentry menu, which counts your chests and the storage depot and moves missing materials into your bag when you build (toggle with `UseDepotForCrafting` in `config.json`)

- Stack counts above 999 are shown as +999 to keep slots tidy

- Capacity is the total slots of your linked chests, shown in the menu

Requires

- Stardew Valley 1.6.15 (Android)

- SMAPI Android Launcher 4.1.0 or newer

- ARM64 device

Notes

- Android only, not compatible with PC

- Host-only in multiplayer

- Auto-Deposit needs at least one linked chest

- The crafting menu uses linked chests only; the storage depot is counted in Robin's menu only

- Gift search uses the game's own gift tastes, so it follows any mod that changes them. A custom villager must be loaded in the world to be found

Credits

- Takt
